entities.name: Nivea
entities.description: Mage of Otaria who summoned white creatures and died at Phage's hands in a Cabal pit fight.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Illusionist and fortune teller, Nivea's love, who created Akroma in her image.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Angel Ixidor created in Nivea's image.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Killed Nivea in a Cabal pit fight.

entities.name: Order of the northern plains
entities.description: Mage order Nivea belonged to until its decimation.

events.summary: Nivea abandoned the remnants of her order, traveled to Aphetto and met Ixidor.
events.quote: she met Ixidor , an illusionist who worked as a street fortune teller

events.summary: Nivea and Ixidor bet on themselves in Cabal pit fights.
events.quote: Nivea partnered with her love to make their living betting on themselves

events.summary: Nivea died at the hands of Phage in a Cabal pit fight.
events.quote: She died at the hands of Phage in a Cabal pit fight.

events.summary: In his grief Ixidor created the angel Akroma in her image.
events.quote: In his grief, Ixidor created the angel Akroma in her image.
